protocol.selection_aggregation: Mean prompt AUC within each selection perturbation type, then equal average across selection types
protocol.evaluation_aggregation: Mean group AUC across variants within each held-out type
protocol.primary_metric: Held-out ROC AUC per perturbation type
protocol.resampling: Split recorded outputs without replacement. Within each pool, independently bootstrap reference and detection samples with replacement.
protocol.cost_scope: Detection requests only; discovery, selection and reference collection costs excluded.
limitations: Ten previously collected candidate Border Inputs

Collection spans sessions; recovery checks are recorded separately
